purpose: Teach: 天神/芦屋/藤岡/萩原/フィジカル/エキサイトブログ/ハンナ/ケインズ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが福岡天神のお土産を下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's bringing back a souvenir from Fukuoka Tenjin for you.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Gentle opening, like she's sharing something pleasant she noticed. Unhurried delivery, the cadence of a mother sharing small good news.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと芦屋の高級住宅街の写真集観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at a photo book of the fancy neighborhoods in Ashiya.
lines.style: Bright, direct delivery. Quick opening attack on the first word—he's eager to share what he did. Unguarded excitement, the genuine enthusiasm of a child reporting his day.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが藤岡弘、の伝記を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been reading a biography of Hiroshi Fujioka.
lines.style: Calm, observant tone. Slight pause before 'biography'—she's noticing something about what he's into. Quiet wonder in her voice, like she's following a thread about him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと萩原朔太郎の詩集観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at a poetry collection by Sakutaro Hagiwara.
lines.style: Quick, earnest opening. His voice carries pride that they experienced something together. Simple, direct delivery—no performance, just genuine sharing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジムでフィジカル鍛錬を続けてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been keeping up with his physical training at the gym.
lines.style: Gentle observation. Slight admiration woven through. Unhurried pacing, like she's noticing and cataloging something she values about him in a private way.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとエキサイトブログの料理ブログ見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a cooking blog on Excite Blog.
lines.style: Bright, open delivery with a lift at the end. He's reporting a simple shared moment like it matters to him. Unself-conscious joy, no irony—just a child's genuine delight.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが米国ピアニスト、ハンナのCDを流してらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been listening to pianist Hanna's CD.
lines.style: Soft, knowing tone. A slight smile audible in the words. Gentle pacing, the voice of someone noticing and appreciating a partner's quiet interests.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと経済学者ケインズのドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a documentary about economist Keynes.
lines.style: Warm, satisfied closing. A sense of accomplishment in sharing something interesting with his father. The moment lands clearly—he's proud of what they did together. Slight warmth on the final word.
